title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.27.0 adds numbered step badges that show execution order on multi-line Kotlin Flow chains.

highlights.title: Flow Chain Step Badges
highlights.description: Numbered badges next to each step in a multi-line Kotlin Flow chain show the order operators run, so you can trace map, filter, and collect calls without counting lines by hand.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added numbered badges on multi-line Kotlin Flow chains, marking the order each operator executes so long chains are easier to read at a glance.
Available in both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.
Can be turned off via the kotlinJump.flowChainBadges setting.
